Date: 2026-07-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Endorsement rotation: blackout overlap & committee queue alignment

Team —

Quick note on the senior IC packet for Rohan Mehta (eng). We received the evidence bundle yesterday and I returned a short advocate handback with clarifications (attached). Two constraints to surface:

- Monica is in the rotation to act as primary advocate for this cycle, but her PTO blackout overlaps with the committee window (Aug 2–4).
- Marcus will be traveling Aug 3–5 (red-eye travel), which narrows slots where two advocates + HR can join for the canary review.

Ask: can we confirm who will take the primary advocate role and whether we can request a narrow exception to the blackout window for Monica, or swap her slot? If neither, we should move this packet to the next queue to keep the committee review clean.

Attachments: advocate_handback_notes_sean.pdf (3 pages — clarifications on impact statements), evidence_bundle_rohan_2026-07-28.pdf (attached by manager).

Proposed next steps (quick):
1) Monica to confirm availability or propose an alternate advocate by end of day.
2) Marcus to flag any critical supporting evidence he needs added.
3) Laura to confirm HR availability for signoff and whether we can flex the blackout for a single review.

If we can lock the advocate pair and HR, I will schedule a 30-minute canary slot and upload the final packet.

Thanks —
Sean Gallagher
Director, Eng Productivity
Redwood Inference

I'll also review Sean's handback and update the evidence bundle with a one-paragraph clarification on the scaling impact.

Folks —

Thanks for the quick back-and-forth. HR is comfortable allowing a single 30-minute exception to the blackout for an essential canary review provided: 

1) The candidate and direct manager do not attend the advocate-focused portion (keeps impartiality).
2) We capture a short decision note (template attached) and obtain one upstream leader sign-off following the committee.

Sean — please schedule the canary for Aug 2 at 10:30 PT if Monica confirms. Marcus — thanks for the addendum; I'll merge that into the packet.

I've uploaded the HR signoff template and started a DocuSign envelope for the post-committee acknowledgement: https://redwood.docusign.com/envelopes/ABCD-1234. Please review and route once the packet is final.
